content: The abomination of desolation is the court withdrawing enforcement from an enclosure a counterfeit identity has occupied — Daniel's covenant broken at the midpoint, the daily offering cut off, the unclean thing standing in the holy place, and the desolation that returns the enclosure to the Genesis void until the rightful I AM re-enters. title: Exodus 3:1-14 With Moses and the Burning Bush — The Court Declares From the Thorn, Not the Garden
content: Moses is led to Horeb, the waste ground, where a thorn-tree burns and is not consumed. He removes his shoes on holy ground, hears the court name itself after the patriarchs, and receives Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh — I AM THAT I AM. The court delivers its highest instrument from the driest, thorniest ground it has, not the cultivated one.
